say:2:1430208301:1.text: I heard that the Queen died! Now all men in Sal'thorin are equal! There's no longer any nobility!
say:2:1430208301:1.source_cn: 我听说女王出事了！而且从今往后萨洛克兰城中所有人平等，...

say:2:1430208301:1.female: I heard that the Queen died! Now all men in Sal'thorin are equal! There's no longer any nobility!

say:3:1430208302:1.text: This is great news, my friend. Haven't we looked forward to this day since we were young?
say:3:1430208302:1.source_cn: 这是好事，我的朋友。之前我们不一直期待着这天到来吗？
